look.why: A deep tropical canopy green evoking Southeast Asian rainforests and contrasting with the shaggy charcoal coat.

size.measure: nose to tail tip, about 1.65 m (body 61–96 cm plus thick prehensile tail 56–89 cm per ADW)

habitat.text: Dense primary and secondary tropical rainforests across mainland Southeast Asia, Sumatra, Java, Borneo and Palawan.

diet.text: Strangler figs, wild fruits, shoots, leaves, insects, birds, eggs and small forest mammals.

facts.text: Scent glands under its tail release a compound (2-AP) that smells remarkably like warm buttered popcorn.
It is one of only two carnivores—alongside the kinkajou—with a truly prehensile tail strong enough to support its full weight.

id.habitat: Hutan hujan tropis lebat di daratan Asia Tenggara, Sumatra, Jawa, Kalimantan, dan Palawan.
id.diet: Buah ara (beringin), buah-buahan hutan, pucuk daun, serangga, burung, telur, dan mamalia kecil.
facts: Kelenjar aroma di bawah ekornya menghasilkan senyawa (2-AP) yang berbau persis seperti berondong jagung mentega hangat.
Salah satu dari hanya dua karnivora di dunia yang memiliki ekor prehensil kuat untuk mencengkeram dahan pohon.
